name: impeccable-skill-deps
description: Runtime dependencies for the vendored Impeccable detector. Node resolves the detector's bare imports by walking up from scripts/detector/engines/, so this directory is where they have to live -- src/main/frontend/node_modules is on a different branch of the tree and cannot satisfy them. Without these the detector silently falls back to regex matching: no computed contrast, no custom properties, no selector matching. Versions track the published `impeccable` package's own dependencies.
